title: #TGIF
bodyHtml:
Hey human.

You made it to Friday!
Time to shake off the week like loose fur.

We cats know the secret to a good weekend:

  • - stretch
  • - snack
  • - nap
  • - repeat

No guilt. No rushing. Just existing in your favorite spot
until the world slows down to match your purr.

Let the stress fall away, like shedding season for your soul.
